newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps reviewing Olympic rating.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps reviewing Olympic rating.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Tuesday it placed Olympic Financial Ltd's $145 million senior unsecured notes on rating watch with uncertain implications following Olympic's announcement it may be sold.
Minneapolis-based Olympic said Monday it received an expression of interest in the company but did not disclose the name of the suitor.
Duff & Phelps currently rates Olympic's senior unsecured notes double-B.

"Given the market value of the company and management's desire for a well-capitalized parent, we do not expect a lower-rated entity to acquire Olympic. Therefore, it is unlikely an ownership change would result in a downgrade," the credit rating agency said.
"However, a prolonged period of uncertainty regarding the company's ownership may place downward pressure on the current rating if Olympic's strategic direction changes," it said.
Olympic has indicated its operations will not change, Duff & Phelps said. "We view Olympic as having a well-devised underwriting system and an impressive proprietary credit scoring model."
